map.由角速度求旋转周期 使用指南: Deriving the Rotation Period from Angular Velocity User Guide
map.由角速度求周期工具依据 T=2π/ω 将角速度换算为旋转周期，输入 ω 输出周期: The period from angular velocity tool uses T = 2*pi/omega to convert angular velocity into a rotation period, taking omega and returning period T, suited to frequency and period conversion in circular motion, waves and mechanical rotation.
map.输入角速度 ω，求周期 T。: Enter the angular velocity omega to get the period T.
map.角速度转一圈耗时。: Time for one full rotation from angular velocity.
map.把角速度换算成转一圈所需的周期。: Convert angular velocity into the period for one full rotation.
map.：T = 2π/6.283 = 1 s。即角速度 6.283 rad/s 时每圈: T = 2*pi/6.283 = 1 s, so at an angular velocity of 6.283 rad/s each rotation takes 1 second.
map.：T=2π/ω=6.28318/1.5708=4.0000 s，即每 4 秒完成: T = 2*pi/omega = 6.28318/1.5708 = 4.0000 s, so one rotation completes every 4 seconds.
map.由初速与仰角求水平竖直分量: Horizontal and vertical components from initial speed and launch angle
map.由两物体速度求相对速度: Relative velocity from the velocities of two objects
map.T=1/f；周期 1 秒即频率 1 Hz，两者一致。: T=1/f; a period of 1 second means a frequency of 1 Hz, which is consistent.
map.周期和频率有什么关系？: What is the relation between period and frequency?
map.互为倒数：T=1/f。本例 T=4.0000 s 对应 f=0.25 Hz。注意: They are reciprocals: T = 1/f. Here T = 4.0000 s corresponds to f = 0.25 Hz. Note that omega cannot be 0, since zero angular velocity means no rotation, the period tends to infinity, and the tool would return a meaningless result.
